claims: As of March 2026, Fran McCaffery is the head coach of the University of Pennsylvania men's basketball team.
Fran McCaffery was hired in March 2025.
USA Today reported that Fran McCaffery led the University of Pennsylvania men's basketball team to the 2026 Ivy League Tournament Championship.
USA Today reported that Fran McCaffery secured a berth in the NCAA Tournament for the University of Pennsylvania men's basketball team during his first season.
A 59-second CBS Philadelphia video on YouTube dated April 7, 2025 shows the introduction of Fran McCaffery as the new head coach.
Fran McCaffery is a University of Pennsylvania alumnus (W'82).
Fran McCaffery had a 15-season tenure at Iowa.
Fran McCaffery returned to coaching at his alma mater following his 15-season tenure at Iowa.
Hawkeyes Wire says that McCaffery led the Quakers to an 18-11 record in the 2025-26 season.
Hawkeyes Wire says that McCaffery led the Quakers to an Ivy League Tournament title in his first year.
Facebook notes that Penn is the fifth program guided by Fran McCaffery to the NCAA Tournament.
The University of Pennsylvania Athletics website shows that Jim Ricci serves as the women's basketball coach.
